research_question: Do four mechanically distinct models, frozen from the discovery-only comparison of close-above-open versus nonpositive sessions, produce robust net open-to-close returns in the untouched 2024-11-01 through 2025-07-31 confirmation window?

authority.reason: The confirmation window is historically available and earlier project generations have inspected related outcomes. This locked run can reject a candidate family or nominate one unique variant for a future forward shadow only; it cannot establish production performance.

stable_signal_rule.slice_sign: all three discovery slices have the same non-zero sign as the aggregate

point_in_time_contract.label: 1 only when same-session close is strictly greater than open; close equal to open is class 0
point_in_time_contract.feature_latest_source: the immediately preceding completed official session
point_in_time_contract.monthly_fit_rule: For a score month, training labels end on the last scheduled session of the preceding calendar month. No outcome from the score month can enter that month's fit.
point_in_time_contract.dmd_fit_rule: At the first scheduled session of each score month, fit one operator from the fixed number of completed official states immediately before that month. Freeze that operator and code mapping for the entire month. Each target date applies it to the immediately preceding completed actual state, so same-month completed states can update the input state but never refit the operator.
point_in_time_contract.missing_history: Do not bridge a missing official state. A missing or non-traded completed-state coordinate is the registered neutral rank 0. A current-date code must still satisfy price eligibility. A month with inadequate numerical rank remains cash.
point_in_time_contract.tie_break: Higher score, then security code ascending.

hypotheses.claim: A low-rank linear evolution of the completed cross-stock open-to-close rank field contains next-session directional structure that is not represented by row-wise rolling aggregates.
Joint low-rank evolution of completed morning, lunch-gap, and afternoon rank fields captures intraday component rotation that predicts the next open-to-close ordering.
The discovery-stable lunch low-frequency energy and overnight high-frequency/dominant-frequency signals interact nonlinearly, so a small deterministic neural readout can improve selection.
The discovery-stable path-complexity ranks have distinct class-conditional distributions, so a Gaussian generative classifier can rank the close-above-open probability.

rank_transform.scope: within each official date among finite eligible rows

registered_candidates.state: cross-stock within-date rank of completed open-to-close return
registered_candidates.matrix: At month start m, X=[state(m-60),...,state(m-2)] and Y=[state(m-59),...,state(m-1)] over the immediately preceding 60 official states.
registered_candidates.operator: Y V_r diag(1/s_r) U_r^T from the exact thin SVD of X, frozen for every score date in month m
registered_candidates.score: frozen monthly operator applied to the immediately preceding completed actual state
registered_candidates.code_mapping: security codes with at least one observed completed OC state in the pre-month fit window, sorted ascending and frozen for the month
registered_candidates.numerical_failure: If fewer than 60 consecutive pre-month states, fewer than 8 singular values, or numerical rank below 8, leave both slots as cash for the entire month.

registered_candidates.state: vertical stack, in AM/lunch/PM order, of cross-stock within-date ranks for completed AM return, lunch gap, and PM return
registered_candidates.matrix: At month start m, X=[state(m-32),...,state(m-2)] and Y=[state(m-31),...,state(m-1)] over the immediately preceding 32 official states.
registered_candidates.operator: Y V_r diag(1/s_r) U_r^T from the exact thin SVD of X, frozen for every score date in month m
registered_candidates.score: arithmetic mean of the AM, lunch, and PM components predicted by the frozen monthly operator from the immediately preceding completed actual stacked state
registered_candidates.code_mapping: security codes with at least one observed completed state in each of AM, lunch, and PM during the pre-month fit window, sorted ascending and frozen for the month
registered_candidates.numerical_failure: If fewer than 32 consecutive pre-month states, fewer than 12 singular values, or numerical rank below 12, leave both slots as cash for the entire month.

registered_candidates.sample_weight: each training date has total weight one

registered_candidates.input: within-date ranks mapped to [-1,1], multiplied by the frozen discovery direction
registered_candidates.sample_weight: each training date has total weight one

control.purpose: Same source, universe, confirmation schedule, costs, and capacity comparator; not part of the candidate family.

confirmation.cash_rule: Every scheduled session has exactly capacity slots. Missing selections and unexecuted slots remain cash and incur no cost.

checks: overall mean net return at 40 bp is strictly positive
overall mean net return at 60 bp is strictly positive
mean net return at 40 bp is strictly positive in each of the three fixed confirmation slices
mean net return at 40 bp remains strictly positive after removing the 10 best scheduled days
mean net return at 40 bp remains strictly positive after replacing every selection from the 10 most profitable security codes with cash
at least 6 of 9 calendar months have a strictly positive mean net return at 40 bp
the Bonferroni-adjusted one-sided 90% paired moving-block lower bound against the same-capacity C00 control is non-negative
at least 100 unique security codes are selected
no single security code exceeds 5% of selected non-cash slots
the 10 most selected security codes together do not exceed 25% of selected non-cash slots
at least 150 scheduled sessions contain an executed slot
at least 80% of scheduled capacity slots are executed
qualification_gate.result_authority: A unique passer may only be frozen for a new forward shadow. No passer or multiple passers produce no nomination. Production and order permissions remain unchanged.

anti_leakage_tests: close equal to open is class 0
mutating target-session or future OHLC cannot change a target-session DMD state or score
DMD state columns map back to security codes exactly; operators are fit once from pre-month consecutive states and each score uses only the immediately preceding completed state
every monthly classifier/control training date is strictly before the first date of its score month
same-month outcome mutation cannot change any score from that month
equal scores are ordered by security code ascending
metric and gate calculations preserve all 182 scheduled sessions and fixed cash slots
stop_rule: Run all 8 registered candidate/capacity variants once after this protocol, its runner, its tests, and the v1.4 input erratum are committed remotely. Do not alter features, directions, DMD ranks or lookbacks, classifier parameters, capacities, costs, gates, dates, or multiplicity after reading a confirmation result.
